text:
maria: Quick sync — we're finalizing the external release post for next Tuesday 9am PT. Need a final thumbs on the changelog link + any docs anchors that should be highlighted.

ken: Pinged for the changelog review. It's almost done, adding the dedicated capacity notes and the Optimize tips. Will push URL by EOD.

olivia: For the benchmark narrative we want a short callout about endpoint latency at p95 and token-cost delta vs baseline. Ken, can you confirm numbers we can quote?

ken: p95 = 210ms on small batch, 320ms under steady burst (reserved). Cost delta ~ -28% vs our previous config when using KV cache + batching. I'll gen a tiny table and paste it.

sam: Heading: "New release — predictable latency & cheaper tokens"? Or something less marketing-y. Also, webinar slot on Wed looks tight; we can do Tues afternoon demo for press. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: Love the headline. Keep it customer-focused. For webinar: demo -> Wed 9am PT works better for product folks. Marketing can host Tue 4pm dry-run.

harpreet: FYI the docs anchors to surface: /docs/intro, /docs/dedicated, /docs/optimize/batching. Recommend we link directly to /docs/release/2026-03-inference-updates (will create).

ken: Changelog preview (snippet):
```
- Dedicated: reserved GPU pools now support burst autoscaling and SLA labeling.
- Optimize: automatic KV prefix caching enabled by default for small-sequence workloads.
- Runtime: improved kernel selection reduces token cost by ~28% on standard benchmarks.
```
I'll upload full changelog to the release folder shortly.

maria: Can someone drop the full changelog URL here when ready? I'll pin it into the release doc and include in the press packet. :pushpin:

deploy-bot: release branch `release/2026-03-inference-updates` created by ken at 2026-03-10T18:00:12Z

ken: Full changelog: https://redwood.example.com/releases/2026-03-inference-updates/changelog.html — still finalizing a few wording tweaks.

olivia: Thanks — I'll draft the benchmark paragraph using the numbers Ken posted. One ask: can we get a graph export (png) of latency vs load for the blog? Ken, can you or infra export?

ken: Will export a PNG from the bench dashboard and upload to the shared drive by 5pm.

maria: Lead routing — inbound demo signups should route to AE team variant B (email nurture sequence 2). @sam can you confirm the webhook payload keys so Eng can wire it?

sam: webhook payload is `email, plan, interest_tags, utm_campaign, lead_source`. I'll paste sample later.

ken: Quick note on rollout timing: we should stagger traffic to the new model variant across regions for 2 hours, then full. Ops will run the canary.

harpreet: Ops checklist: canary deploy -> validate p95 < 500ms -> check cost metrics -> flip. I added this to the release runbook.

maria: Perfect. Final asks: 1) changelog URL in thread (done), 2) docs release path (Harpreet to create), 3) PNG graph (Ken), 4) webhook sample (Sam). If we hit these by EOD, Marketing will publish draft and schedule the 4pm dry-run.

olivia: I'll also prepare two subject-line options for the announcement email and a 60s webinar teaser script.

maria: Thanks team — ping here when each item is done. :rocket:
